basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 34-year-old gamer based in Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me a pretty flexible schedule. Outside of work, I'm really into gaming, motorcycles, and checking out new tech. I returned to Rocket League after a long break and I'm just looking to have some fun without the pressure of ranked matches. I usually hop online in the evenings, especially over the weekends. Not currently in a relationship, just enjoying life and making new friends online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and I've been designing professionally for over a decade. Most of my game-related knowledge comes from years of playing and staying updated with gaming news and forums. I've also picked up a fair amount about motorcycles from online communities and personal experience.
